   271→sealed trait JsonValue
   272→object JsonValue {

   274→  case class JsonNumber(value: Double) extends JsonValue
   275→  case class JsonBool(value: Boolean) extends JsonValue
   276→  case object JsonNull extends JsonValue

   284→    case JsonBool(b)    => b

   290→  private def escapeJsonString(s: String): String = {

   292→    s.foreach {
   293→      case '"'  => sb.append("\\\"")
   294→      case '\\' => sb.append("\\\\")
   295→      case '\b' => sb.append("\\b")
   296→      case '\f' => sb.append("\\f")
   297→      case '\n' => sb.append("\\n")
   298→      case '\r' => sb.append("\\r")
   299→      case '\t' => sb.append("\\t")
   300→      case c if c < ' ' =>
   301→        sb.append("\\u%04x".format(c.toInt))
   302→      case c => sb.append(c)
   303→    }
   304→    sb.append("\"")
   305→    sb.toString
   306→  }

   308→  private def formatNumber(n: Double): String = {
   309→    if (n == n.toLong && !n.isInfinite) n.toLong.toString

   313→  def toJsonString(jv: JsonValue, pretty: Boolean = false, indent: Int = 0): String = {

   315→    val nextIndent = indent + 1
   316→    val nextIndentStr = if (pretty) "  " * nextIndent else ""
   317→    val sep = if (pretty) ",\n" else ", "
   318→    val colonSep = if (pretty) ": " else ": "

   322→      case JsonNumber(n)  => formatNumber(n)
   323→      case JsonBool(b)    => b.toString
   324→      case JsonNull       => "null"
   325→      case JsonArray(items) if items.isEmpty => "[]"
   326→      case JsonArray(items) =>

   339→          }
   340→          s"{\n${entries.mkString(",\n")}\n$indentStr}"
   341→        } else {
   342→          val entries = fields.map { case (k, v) =>
   343→            s"${escapeJsonString(k)}$colonSep${toJsonString(v, pretty = false)}"
   344→          }
   345→          s"{${entries.mkString(sep)}}"
   346→        }
   347→    }
   348→  }
   349→}

   355→  }
   356→
   357→  def tokenizePath(value: JsonValue, path: String): Option[Token] = {
   358→    val parts = path.split("\\.")
   359→
   360→    def navigate(current: JsonValue, remaining: List[String]): Option[JsonValue] =
   361→      remaining match {
   362→        case Nil => Some(current)
   363→        case part :: rest => current match {
   364→          case JsonValue.JsonObject(fields) =>
   365→            fields.get(part).flatMap(navigate(_, rest))
   366→          case JsonValue.JsonArray(items) =>
   367→            Try(part.toInt).toOption
   368→              .filter(idx => idx >= 0 && idx < items.length)
   369→              .map(items(_))
   370→              .flatMap(navigate(_, rest))
   371→          case _ => None
   372→        }
   373→      }
   374→
   375→    navigate(value, parts.toList).map(tokenize)
   376→  }
   377→}

   379→// ============================================================================
   380→// Whitespace Tokenizer - Basic Text Tokenization
   381→// ============================================================================
   382→
   383→class WhitespaceTokenizer(
   384→    lowercase: Boolean = false,
   385→    minLength: Int = 0,
   386→    maxLength: Option[Int] = None,
   387→    stripPunctuation: Boolean = false
   388→) {
   389→  private val punctuation: Set[Char] =
   390→    ".,!?;:'\"()[]{}".toSet
   391→
   392→  private def processToken(word: String): Option[String] = {
   393→    var w = word
   394→    if (stripPunctuation) {
   395→      w = w.dropWhile(punctuation.contains).reverse.dropWhile(punctuation.contains).reverse
   396→    }
   397→    if (lowercase) {
   398→      w = w.toLowerCase
   399→    }
   400→    if (w.length < minLength) return None
   401→    maxLength.foreach { max =>
   402→      if (w.length > max) w = w.take(max)
   403→    }
   404→    if (w.isEmpty) None else Some(w)
   405→  }
   406→
   407→  def tokenize(text: String): List[Token] = {
   408→    val words = text.split("\\s+").filter(_.nonEmpty)
   409→    words.zipWithIndex.flatMap { case (word, i) =>
   410→      processToken(word).map { processed =>
   411→        Token(
   412→          value = processed,
   413→          tokenType = TokenType.String,
   414→          metadata = Map("position" -> i, "original" -> word)
   415→        )
   416→      }
   417→    }.toList
   418→  }
   419→
   420→  def tokenizeToStrings(text: String): List[String] =
   421→    tokenize(text).map(_.value)
   422→
   423→  def tokenizeWithPositions(text: String): List[(String, Int, Int)] = {
   424→    val result = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[(String, Int, Int)]
   425→    var currentPos = 0
   426→
   427→    for (word <- text.split("\\s+").filter(_.nonEmpty)) {
   428→      val start = text.indexOf(word, currentPos)
   429→      val end = start + word.length
   430→
   431→      processToken(word).foreach { processed =>
   432→        result += ((processed, start, end))
   433→      }
   434→      currentPos = end
   435→    }
   436→    result.toList
   437→  }
   438→
   439→  def countTokens(text: String): Int =
   440→    tokenize(text).length
   441→}
   442→
   443→// ============================================================================
   444→// Builder Pattern with Fluent Interface
   445→// ============================================================================
   446→
   447→class TokenizerBuilder[T] {
   448→  private val _normalizers: mutable.ListBuffer[String => String] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   449→  private val _validators: mutable.ListBuffer[T => Boolean] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   450→  private var _metadata: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
   451→
   452→  def withNormalizer(normalizer: String => String): TokenizerBuilder[T] = {
   453→    _normalizers += normalizer
   454→    this
   455→  }
   456→
   457→  def withValidator(validator: T => Boolean): TokenizerBuilder[T] = {
   458→    _validators += validator
   459→    this
   460→  }
   461→
   462→  def withMetadata(entries: (String, Any)*): TokenizerBuilder[T] = {
   463→    _metadata = _metadata ++ entries.toMap
   464→    this
   465→  }
   466→
   467→  def build(): T => Token = {
   468→    val normalizers = _normalizers.toList
   469→    val validators = _validators.toList
   470→    val metadata = _metadata
   471→
   472→    (value: T) => {
   473→      validators.foreach { validator =>
   474→        if (!validator(value))
   475→          throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Validation failed for $value")
   476→      }
   477→
   478→      var strValue = value.toString
   479→      normalizers.foreach { normalizer =>
   480→        strValue = normalizer(strValue)
   481→      }
   482→
   483→      Token(strValue, TokenType.String, metadata)
   484→    }
   485→  }
   486→}
